_comment: User-study picks after visual inspection of every iteration preview (not only the critic). run = output dir on scratch; B = iter_<iter>_av.mp4 (16 steps, same noise as baseline_av.mp4) or optimized_final_av.mp4 when iter = 'final'.

goldfish.note: clean leap out of the tank; baseline never jumps
goldfish.edit: The goldfish jumps out of the fish tank into the air.

cat_yawns.note: wide early yawn (frames ~30-50); baseline yawns only in the last frame. alt: iter 9

man_shouts.note: hands come up from mid-clip and an open-mouth shout; baseline raises hands only in the last frames

boy_splashes.edit: The boy splashes the water with both hands.
boy_splashes.note: two-handed splash with water spraying up mid-clip (frames ~40-65); baseline only stands up out of the water. alt: iters 7, 8, 10

man_claps.note: RESERVE - clear sustained clapping (frames ~20-110) but H3 zooms out to a wider shot to show the hands (baseline is a tight face shot where hands meet once for ~3 frames). alt: iter 3. Framing change = weaker preservation.

car_door_opens.note: the driver door of the car on the lift swings open mid-clip (from frame ~45) and stays open, scene otherwise unchanged; baseline door never opens. alt: iters 3, 5. iters 6+ add extra people/objects (drift).

gen_woman_desk.note: user pick: iter 2 (wide yawn). Note: the run's own baseline also scored 0.91 on the critic.

gen_sealion.edit: The sea lion barks with its head raised.
gen_sealion.note: user pick: iter 2 best, iter 3 candidate; iter 4 added as candidate (critic best, 0.94); baseline opens the mouth only at the very end.

gen_koi_pond.edit: The koi jumps out of the water.
gen_koi_pond.note: user pick: best (final = iter 6 latents) with iters 4 and 6 as candidates; critic stayed flat at 0.003 - a critic miss, the jump is visible to a human.

gen_dolphin_sea.edit: The dolphin leaps out of the water.
gen_dolphin_sea.note: user pick: iter 2 (run still in progress when picked; revisit later iterations when done).
